helpers.name: searchable-dropdown-pick
helpers.widget: searchable dropdown that saves a value only when an option is clicked
helpers.description: Types the start of the option, waits for the list, and clicks the exact option. Returns the visible value.

args.input: CSS selector of the search box

helpers.name: chip-entry-add
helpers.widget: chip or tag field that adds an entry only on an Enter keydown and clears its box on blur
helpers.description: For each value, sets the entry box, fires input, then fires Enter keydown/keypress/keyup without blurring. Skips values already saved. Returns the saved list read from the state field.

args.input: CSS selector of the entry box
args.values: array of exact entries to add
args.state: optional CSS selector of the field holding the saved JSON array, used for readback
